svg.title: Taxi driver — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as taxi driver, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A front-view taxi has a clearly raised roof sign, sloping windscreen, low bonnet and separate wheels. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a tapered face.
